SUPPLEMENTAL RESTRAINT SYSTEM - SIDE AIRBAG SENSOR ASSEMBLY
INSPECTION
1. VEHICLES NOT INVOLVED IN COLLISION
Do a diagnostic system check (See page Ol-326).
2. VEHICLE INVOLVED IN COLLISION AND AIRBAG IS NOT DEPLOYED
Do a diagnostic system check {See page Ol-326).
3. VEHICLE INVOLVED IN COLLISION AND AIRBAG IS DEPLOYED
Replace the side airbag sensor assembly (See page D1-326),
